title: Upload pathology and diagnostic imaging results to My Health Record
what: Specified pathology and diagnostic imaging information must be shared with the My Health Record system within 24 hours.

laws.title: My Health Record (Share by Default) Rules 2025

sources.title: My Health Record (Share by Default) Rules 2025
sources.quote: 13 Pathology services—period for sharing information with the My Health Record system (1) For the purposes of subsection 78A(1) of the Act, this section specifies the period within which information specified in section 12 of this instrument must be shared with the My Health Record system. (2) The specified period is the period of 24 hours

reach.condition: if it provides pathology or diagnostic imaging services
